mapping.sheet: Default wall sheet 1.6 mm, adjustable 1.6–2 mm. Base/roof redesigned 2–2.6 mm.
mapping.socket: Preserve measured 4.5 mm interface width. Two tongues per wall, sheet thick and base/roof thickness deep. Openings (sheet+fit)x(4.5+fit).
mapping.clearance: Proposed TOTAL .15 mm default, .1–.3 mm range; NOT measured source .100012 mm gap. Calibrate and bond four fixed joints.
mapping.tabs: 16 Boolean-unioned accessible runners, .8–1.4 mm wide and .4–.6 mm thick; increased from source .21/.22 mm low runner planes; snip 1.6 mm outside edges.

originalDesign.interaction: Transmission grating viewing bench. Printed slit backing is 1–2 mm, external foil narrows actual slit to .1–.3 mm; grating film and opaque paper wrap required. No optical simulation.
originalDesign.assembly: Lower both walls into base then roof over upper tongues. Four fixed adhesive seats. No locked or moving parts.
originalDesign.art: Base extension,13mm protected diameter patch away from slots/beam. .4–.6mm engraving leaves>=1.4mm backing.
